RagShortTexts: Tides, water and vessel repair limit coastal action.
Sailing and land warnings share limited people.

Variants.Content: Coastal operations depend on tide, water, repair and landings. Land fighters also need food; sending every person aboard leaves fields and routes unguarded.

Tides, water and vessel repair limit coastal action. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Sailing and land warnings share limited people.
Sailing and land warnings share limited people. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Tides, water and vessel repair limit coastal action.
Tides, water and vessel repair limit coastal action. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Sailing and land warnings share limited people.
Sailing and land warnings share limited people. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Tides, water and vessel repair limit coastal action.
